tagline: Memory foam that holds its shape, in corduroy you won't want to hide.
lead: A memory foam bed smart enough to sit out in the room, so your dog stays where the company is.
value: The cover is corduroy furniture fabric, not coated nylon, over a memory foam core rather than fibre filling that packs into ridges.
intro: Spruce is a memory foam dog bed with cushioned bolsters and a tactile corduroy cover, in Small, Medium and Large and in Beige, Grey or Green. The cover comes off and washes at 30°C.
points: Foam that holds its shape, not fibre filling that packs down into ridges.
Cushioned sides for the dog who always sleeps against something.
A ribbed, tactile cover in Beige, Grey or Green that suits the furniture.
The cover comes off and goes in the machine, following the sewn-in care label.
best_for: Small and medium dogs who sleep against something, in rooms where you'd rather not hide the bed.
fit_note: These are outside measurements and the bolsters take up a good part of them, so measure your dog curled up rather than stretched out. Between sizes, size up, or ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Unzip the cover and wash it at 30°C, following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Corduroy Memory Foam Dog Bed with Bolsters | Snoozly
seo_description: A memory foam dog bed in tactile corduroy, with cushioned bolsters to rest a chin on. Small to Large in Beige, Grey or Green; the cover washes at 30°C.
alt: Spruce corduroy memory foam dog bed
